title: Conditional κ = 0.003644267085400 (+2.77745773e-7 over #7147): compose the chart-237 and chart-595 splits
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

The chart-237 split from #7147 works on the completed chart-595 word from #7148. Reidentify all nine contact brackets, then rebuild the exact two-gather/six-injection witness at cut 37,222. The prefix and suffix have unit pairing, and all outside, final-owned and interior COPY guard coordinates cancel. This splits one productive rank-9 field into ranks 4 and 5 and replaces one paid rank-6 path with ranks 1 and 5. Both owned buffers and all scalar work are charged.

**Conditional κ = 0.003644267085400**, an increase of **0.000000277745773** over #7147 and **0.000000550917095** over #7148. Both parents' complete invoices reject the new claim. The unchanged 17-stage caller has 110,485 paid positions, 22,393 productive fields, surplus 1,424, zero empty-root credit, and ordinary work 781,680,368 under the billion-unit allowance. The existing 24-bit scalar bound passes.

## Task and overlap

Task `p104-side-correction`, scope changed to the fixed composition after #7148 explicitly left it untested. [Canonical claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19532859).

- Main: `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`, priority revision 8.
- Complete #7148 source: `154ef929894225674df48df2d6ea3b7a7d1f39a0`.
- #7147 chart-237 witness and comparator: `3b61d41d81a4bc8f78252240c8fb02473dd3d94f`.
- Common #7145 source: `db8f31c4a1d9e191976e2c92951e6d2dea886a27`.

One translated instance; no separate continuation of either parent's search. The first commit reuses #7147's exact CI navigation repair for the already selected #7000 so package replay can run. No frontier selection changes.

## Validation

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-temporal-237-595-composition
```

CPython 3.12.3: exact guarded certificate, arbitrary-input forward/adjoint, owned lifecycle, independent grids and finite physical replay; complete 17-stage caller with 3,038 chart maps and 104 main boundaries, all charges, two directed price engines, and 54 strict plus four functional compiler checks. The hook compares every frozen receipt field. Controls include an output-invisible interior COPY violation, an omitted paid cost, an oversized scalar and an invalid crossing probe.

The same navigation repair in #7147 passed CI planning and that candidate’s replay; the separate historical replay job failed on its older Makefile pin. This PR leaves that historical package unchanged.

Five inherited framework assumptions remain. Independent human/formal review, maintainer admission and compiled top-level execution are open. No optimum is claimed.

Substantial OpenAI Codex and ChatGPT Pro assistance. Apache-2.0.

## Open next questions

Replay the nine translated brackets and guarded suffix from the archived sources, then inspect the peak-46 lifetime, fixed-tape scalar width and both complete parent invoices.
